title: Four published help articles rendered their pipe tables as raw text, because the help renderer had no GFM

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-help finder). components/help/help-markdown.tsx renders with react-markdown and no remark-gfm, so the pipe tables in content/help/groups/run-a-program.md, leading/circle-roles.md, spaces/get-paid.md and spaces/plans-and-pricing.md showed as `| --- |` paragraph text to every reader, and to every crawler and answer engine reading the same HTML. CLOSED 2026-10-05: remark-gfm (4.0.1) is wired as the one remark plugin, with table/th/td handlers in the DAWN style of the other handlers; components/help/help-markdown.test.tsx renders a table and asserts a <table>. The Lead training library reads the same component and gains the same.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const c=fs.readFileSync("components/help/help-markdown.tsx","utf8");const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json","utf8"));if(!/remarkPlugins=\{\[remarkGfm\]\}/.test(c)||!(pkg.dependencies||{})["remark-gfm"]){console.error("SCAN-658: the help renderer has no GFM, so the pipe tables in four published help articles render as raw | --- | text.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
